duplicate-node-id.json.why: second node repeats the first node's id (invariant 1)

edge-endpoint-unresolved.json.why: edge points at a node id that does not exist (invariant 2)

parent-unresolved.json.why: node's parent id does not exist (invariant 3)

schema-ref-unresolved.json.why: edge schema_id names a schema that is not in the graph (invariant 4)

ref-schema-id-unresolved.json.why: field ref_schema_id names a schema that is not in the graph (invariant 4)

illegal-node-kind.json.why: node kind 'widget' is not in the enum (invariant 5)

fork-without-source.json.why: edge in an exclusive_group with source null (invariant 9)

tombstone-with-source.json.why: tombstone node that still carries a defining span (invariant 10)

missing-key.json.why: broken_reason key omitted instead of null (invariant 12, §2.5)

branch-ordinal-without-group.json.why: branch_ordinal set on an edge with no exclusive_group (invariant 14)

duplicate-branch-ordinal.json.why: two alternatives in one exclusive_group share branch_ordinal 0 (invariant 15)

skips-tiers-into-external.json.why: external_call edge with non-empty skips_tiers; external is not a depth (invariant 16)

wrong-schema-version.json.why: schema_version 2 against a version 1 model; must fail loudly (handoff §5.2)

canonical-with-volatile.json.why: parsed_at present in a graph validated as canonical shape (graph model §7.3)

line-start-zero.json.why: line_start 0; line numbers are 1-based, so the model's positive lower bound rejects it

line-end-before-start.json.why: a span whose line_end precedes its line_start; a pack must not repair this with null (invariant 21)

span-repo-unknown.json.why: a node span whose repo is not in repos[]; invariant 19 applies per element of sources

tombstone-certain.json.why: a tombstone claiming confidence certain; it appears nowhere in source, so it is always inferred (invariant 22)

duplicate-skips-tier.json.why: skips_tiers lists domain twice; the coupling metric would count one skip as two, so duplicates are rejected rather than deduplicated (invariant 23)

unsorted-edges.json.why: edges[0] and edges[1] swapped; canonical shape requires byte-wise ascending id order (invariant 17)

unsorted-tags.json.why: tags out of ascending order; scalar arrays are sorted in canonical shape (invariant 17)

non-nfc-string.json.why: label contains a decomposed (NFD) character; canonical shape requires NFC (invariant 17)

illegal-id-scope.json.why: node id scope 'widget' is neither a fixed scope nor a repo name; the edge to it is updated so only invariant 18 fires

id-path-mismatch.json.why: repo-scoped node whose source.path disagrees with the path in its id (invariant 18)

repo-named-after-scope.json.why: a repo named 'sql' collides with a fixed id scope (invariant 18); node ids and sources are renamed with it so nothing else fires

skips-tiers-into-topic.json.why: publish edge into a topic with non-empty skips_tiers; a topic is transport, not depth (invariant 16)

skips-tiers-into-tombstone.json.why: broken edge into a tombstone with non-empty skips_tiers; the edge is already flagged is_broken (invariant 16)

skips-tiers-external-tier.json.why: target is a repository placed in tier external by config, not an external_service; external is not a depth whatever the kind (invariant 16)

source-repo-unknown.json.why: edge source.repo names a repo that is not in repos[] (invariant 19)

duplicate-repo-name.json.why: repos[] lists the same repo name twice (invariant 1)

self-parent.json.why: a node whose parent is itself; the parent chain must be a tree (invariant 20)

unsorted-sources.json.why: two spans equal on repo, path and line_start are ordered by line_end descending; the span sort key is total (invariant 17, §7.2)

second-span-repo-unknown.json.why: a multi-span node whose last span names a repo not in repos[] (named to sort last); invariant 19 applies to every element, not only sources[0]

no-span-matches-id-path.json.why: a multi-span node where no span's path is the path in the id; the id must name the declaring file (invariant 18)

wrong-type.json.why: is_entry_point is the string "yes" instead of a boolean

unknown-key.json.why: node carries a key the model does not define

not-an-object.json.why: a JSON array, not a graph object
